name: Animal species detection
tagline: 🦌 Spot animals on camera. Log every one, or alert on the species you name; species, breed and behaviour go to Helix.
description: Catch motion events from a wildlife or outdoor camera, ask Gemini what animal is in the frame and what it is doing, and post the result to Helix. You choose which animal raises the alert when you use the template — it is not fixed to any one species.
summary: Webhook → Gemini analyze (JSON) → log every animal, or only the one you name → Helix event with Animal + Breed + Behavior

inputs.label: What should it log?

sets.match_label: Is it the one we watch for?

inputs.help: Logging everything gives you a Helix timeline of every animal that passed the camera. Naming one turns it into an alert for that species and stays quiet otherwise.

inputs.label: Which animal?
inputs.help: Matched against what Gemini reports, so plain words work — bear, coyote, deer.

inputs.label: How many seconds of video should it look at?
inputs.help: Longer catches more behaviour and costs more per firing.
